<script>
(function(){
    if (!document.body || !document.body.classList.contains('mobile-layout')) return;
    if (window.wdhMobileMenuJsLoader) return;
    window.wdhMobileMenuJsLoader = true;

    var url = 'catalog/view/javascript/plaza/ultimatemenu/menu.js',
        code = null,
        ready = false,
        done = false,
        events = ['pointerdown','touchstart','keydown','wheel'];

    function prepare() {
        fetch(url, {credentials:'same-origin'})
            .then(function(r) {
                if (!r.ok) throw new Error(r.status);
                return r.text();
            })
            .then(function(t) {
                code = t;
                ready = true;
            })
            .catch(function() {
                ready = false;
            });
    }

    function activate() {
        if (done || !ready || !window.jQuery) return;

        done = true;

        var s = document.createElement('script');
        s.text = code + '\n//# sourceURL=' + url;
        document.head.appendChild(s);

        events.forEach(function(ev) {
            window.removeEventListener(ev, activate, false);
        });
    }

    events.forEach(function(ev) {
        window.addEventListener(ev, activate, {passive:true});
    });

    window.addEventListener('load', prepare, {once:true});
})();
</script>
